then.reason: Current Name Indicator is present and not Y; no supported current-name value
Type RACN: the ACN field holds an ARBN, not an ACN

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: Company name as it appears on the register
field_mappings.transformation: When Current Name Indicator equals Y, use trimmed and whitespace-collapsed Company Name as the registered name. When Current Name Indicator is null, use trimmed and whitespace-collapsed Current Name as the current company name for the historical record, per the documented Current Name rule, and do not emit the historical Company Name as current. Otherwise omit.
When Type equals RACN, omit because the ACN field then holds an ARBN. Otherwise parse the ACN value as a typed ACN and validate its checksum.
When ABN equals the documented placeholder 0, omit as no ABN. Otherwise parse the ABN value as a typed ABN and validate its checksum.

field_mappings.semantic_evidence: Date on which a company was registered
field_mappings.transformation: Parse the DD/MM/YYYY date with format %d/%m/%Y; no timezone assumed.
Map only the documented code DRGD (De-registered) to deregistered. All other status codes, including REGD and EXAD, are omitted pending same-field meaning support for their canonical equivalents.
Map the documented codes APTY (Australian proprietary company) and APUB (Australian public company) to company. FNOS, RACN and any other code are omitted.
